_comment: Structural-similarity regions for paosgi-azure-v1. paosgi.com is a desktop-only Nuxt 3 site (no mobile responsive). Origin at mobile viewport=450 renders desktop layout zoomed and cropped. This clone is a mobile-first re-interpretation. Direct pixel comparison is structurally apples-to-oranges; we measure design fidelity by: (1) excluded IP-sensitive regions that intentionally diverge under IP guard (logos, hero gradient with USDT/HK-flag, dealer photos, branded category icons), (2) weighted structural chrome (header bar / footer / pagination) using clone-internal coordinates, (3) layout alignment via grayscale+blur whole-page SSIM. The IP guard compliance carries higher weight because paosgi has dense IP (brands U8/PG/CQ9/Pragmatic/IM/Crown/Sabah) and origin's desktop-only design makes it impossible to mobile-pixel-match without infringing.
